To me, what really makes this entry stand out is the abslute horror of the fact that OH MY GOD IT WAS A REAL PERSON AND THEY BROKE HER!

Seriously. Imagine yourself walking home and then suddenly someone grabs you and you wake up and you can't move, and laying there for years, and then someone finds you, but instead of saving you they poke and prod and test, and everything they do hurts you more and leaves you more unable to move untill finally they break you completely and you can't speak or thnk or move at all…

shudder.

item.title: Re:
item.content:encoded:
It's assumed they asked for a name, otherwise they'd have no leads at all on who it (was) at all. (They can't exactly use DNA tests, or take photos, etc.). It's possible that anybody this person kept in touch with before abduction has either long forgotten or since died. Not to mention, laying on a workbench for ## years is bound to screw with somebody's memory.

Besides, I didn't think that info was really needed. >.> But if more people say it would be better if added then I might as well.

item.content:encoded:
Kinda creepy… I mean damn, imagine what it would be like to be in that sort of situation.

Also, has anyone thought to ask 564 for, I don't know, a NAME? Maybe a date of birth, closest relatives, hometown? Might make finding whoever did this to him (her?) easier, or at least give a lead.

Besides that, it's pretty good, but because the obvious isn't even mentioned, it feels incomplete.
